dispositions.sourceDisposition: Recognizes an externally supplied dividend disclosure assertion. Section 6.6 requires proposed/declared dividends before authorisation not recognised as distributions in the period, their amounts per share, and unrecognised cumulative preference dividends. A legality or distributable-reserves check is supplemental and does not establish these disclosures. The connected typed producer renders explicit scoped facts into a review-required dividend register.

Recognizes an externally supplied financing classification assertion; the token does not reconcile liabilities or prove supplier-finance disclosures. Section 7.19A separately requires opening-to-closing liability reconciliation across financing cash flows, acquisitions/disposals, FX, fair value and other changes. Supplier-finance 7.19C requires terms, beginning/end carrying and provider-paid amounts/lines, comparable due-date ranges and noncash changes; provider-paid impracticability is not a blanket waiver. Connected typed producers create review-required documents without native monetary allocation.

Recognizes an externally supplied note-structure assertion. Present notes systematically as far as practicable and cross-reference statement items to related note information under 8.3. The 8.4 order is normal, not an inflexible mandatory sequence; accept a documented systematic alternative. This structure screen does not establish completeness or compliance of the financial note content.
